text:
3-stage build. Build bloat stay in builder. Prod image get only compiled JS + prod deps.

```dockerfile
# ── Stage 1: Install ALL deps + compile ──────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder

WORKDIR /app

# Copy manifests first → cache layer if src changes but deps don't
COPY package*.json tsconfig.json ./
RUN npm ci

COPY src/ ./src/
RUN npm run build          # tsc output → /app/dist


# ── Stage 2: Prune to prod deps only ─────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS deps

WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev      # no devDeps (ts, @types, etc.)


# ── Stage 3: Final image ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS runtime

ENV NODE_ENV=production
WORKDIR /app

# Non-root user. Security baseline.
RUN addgroup -S appgroup && adduser -S appuser -G appgroup
USER appuser

# Only what prod needs
COPY --from=deps     /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=builder  /app/dist         ./dist
COPY package.json    ./

EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

**Why each choice:**

| Decision | Reason |
|---|---|
| `alpine` base | ~5MB vs ~300MB debian |
| Manifests copied before `src/` | Layer cache skip `npm ci` on code-only changes |
| Stage 2 separate prune | Clean `npm ci --omit=dev` faster/safer than `npm prune` on existing install |
| Non-root user | Container escape = unprivileged. No extra cost. |
| Copy `dist/` not `src/` | TS compiler, source maps, type defs stay in builder |

**Typical size result:**

```
builder     ~400MB  (TS compiler + all deps + source)
deps        ~120MB  (prod deps only)
runtime     ~130MB  (alpine + prod deps + dist JS)
```

**`tsconfig.json` must have:**

```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "outDir": "./dist",
    "rootDir": "./src"
  }
}
```

**`package.json` build script:**

```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc --project tsconfig.json"
  }
}
```

Build: `docker build -t myapp .`
Run: `docker run -p 3000:3000 myapp`
